Welcome to Rexburg! Of all the college towns in the US, you chose the best one. Some of the best activities to do are all around. Whether you have moved here for work, school, or to raise a family, this place is perfect. We have assembled some of the greatest attractions that are near you here in Rexburg, all depending on the amount of time you have.

Our favorite location

If you want a place that is fun for all ages and perfect for any time of year, you should consider "Rexburg Rapids." Rexburg Rapids is an exciting place where you can bring your family to swim. With its location in town, you don't even have to travel very far. Best thing yet though is that if you want to swim in the winter, there aren't as many people there to disturb your dedicated fun time.

Distances are straight-line from campus, scaled to road time. Hours and seasons are typical, so confirm before you go.
